title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular peaks and measured R–R intervals in original PDF 504
fields.reason: R–R intervals: 0.805 s, 0.748 s, 0.65 s, 0.52 s, 0.512 s, 0.935 s, 0.837 s. These describe the short displayed sample, not an independently adjudicated rhythm diagnosis.

fields.basis: Assumed course speed of 25 mm/s; independently checked 150 small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 83.9 bpm; six-second count estimate 80 bpm. These methods differ with phase at the strip endpoints, especially for irregular rhythms. The strip itself has no printed paper-speed label.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Isolated rounded upright pre-QRS candidates are visible in the first three well-separated cycles. Later short cycles show overlap with the preceding post-QRS wave, so the early-cycle result must not be generalized to every beat.

limitations: New wave-field estimates remain provisional and unscored. Range width reflects uncertain endpoints and reader disagreement, not a validated diagnostic category. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established.
The exact original PDF was checked. The inspected waveforms are embedded rasters; larger rendering does not add samples. Expert interpretation may still improve unresolved component identification.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention (PDF pages 228, 230, 231 and 234). Every image grid was checked separately; the assumption is not a per-strip speed label.
Peak positions are approximate to about ±2 source pixels; morphology, low-amplitude P waves and boundaries remain uncertain. This is not a statistical confidence interval.
